## Test Summary

| Sprint item | Type | Automated test required | Manual verification required |

| S6-01 Day 7 source and handoff | Config/Data | Unit source and engine-flow tests | Causal-recall and handoff review |

## Automated Tests Required

### S6-01

- Enumerate exactly the unit and three scenes; reject all Day 7 choices, axis
  deltas, token/qualification/resource mutations, direct resolver imports,
  lifecycle/persistence writes, completion calls, and ending source facts.
- Prove the owned `day7_resolve_ending` call is reached once only after all
  required scenes. Exercise resolver type/value errors and assert no label,
  persistent, achievement, or journal action occurs.

### S6-02

- Audit all actual runtime references against inventory/legal provenance, hash,
  semantic path, and accessibility binding.
- Reject missing, stale, duplicate, planned, external, official, generated, or
  unused asset records.

### S6-03

- Replay all six canonical histories to Day 7. Assert the pre-handoff ordered
  history and axes remain exact and the terminal handoff is singular.
- Capture causal recall at keyboard-only silent/reduced-motion 1280x720 and
  1.5x high-contrast/reduced-motion. Require focus, readable text, no clipping,
  no quick-menu target, and semantic equivalence.

### S6-04

- Require Epic/story/sprint/source/asset/test/evidence/review/smoke/QA records
  to agree, including the `game/` runtime-root convention.
- Reject a claimed ending, epilogue, full-manifest, release, stage, or empty-
  `src/` delivery.

## Manual QA Checklist

- [ ] The approach and recall read as acknowledgement of prior choices, not a
  final override, score report, or ending-selection screen.
- [ ] The surface does not state hidden predicates, tokens, qualifications, or
  unreached route facts.
- [ ] Keyboard-only operation and both approved visual baselines keep the
  causal recall comfortable to read without hover, sound, colour, motion, or
  timed input.
- [ ] The transition feels like one consequence-bearing handoff, not a choice
  of ending; an invalid resolver path visibly does not advance.

## Smoke Test Scope

1. Run the complete Python suite and pinned Ren'Py global suite.
2. Run lint/compile and the Erii dialogue content-constraint scan.
3. Replay six canonical histories through all Day 7 scenes and one owned
   terminal handoff each; assert preservation and failure closure.
4. Verify both accessibility baselines and evidence-bundle integrity.
5. Confirm no ending prose/completion, epilogue, full-manifest, release, or
   external asset scope appears in Sprint 6.

## Readiness Gate

This plan does not authorize an empty handler or test double. It is executable
only after SYS-ENDING supplies the owned terminal adapter and real target labels.
Until then its stories remain Blocked and it cannot receive a smoke or QA PASS.
